channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Barclays Center | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Barclays Center from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Moses Brown on Barclays Center
item.description:
Brown, a New York City product, said after practice Saturday.

“Every time we would drive throughout Brooklyn, I would watch the Barclays Center’s progress every year. That was the new team. I remember, growing up, just liking the colors, the uniforms, everything.”

Moses Brown on Barclays Center, Mar 19, 2023. Source: New York Post.

item.title: Jayson Tatum on Barclays Center
item.description:
Mark Murphy:Tatum on hearing an MVP chant in the Barclays Center:

“It feels good. Especially on the road. You hear it at home, but I'm certain I'm not going to win MVP this year. So just worry about winning each game and that's all that I'm worried about.”

Jayson Tatum on Barclays Center, Apr 24, 2022. Source: Twitter @Murf56.

item.title: Joseph Tsai on Barclays Center
item.description:
Joe Tsai:

“We have said that we will use the voice and platform of the Nets, Liberty and Barclays Center to facilitate empathy and dialogue. In Brooklyn, the Plaza at Flatbush and Atlantic has become a place for people to assemble and have their voice heard. If it continues to serve as a place where everyone from our community – from residents to businesses to police alike – gather peacefully to listen to each other and find common ground, then it’s good with me.”

Joseph Tsai on Barclays Center, Jun 7, 2020. Source: New York Daily News.

item.title: Joseph Tsai on Barclays Center
item.description:
“With full ownership of the Nets and Barclays Center, we will continue to bring our exciting brand of basketball to our fans,”

Joseph Tsai on Barclays Center, Sep 18, 2019. Source: NBA.com.

item.title: Brett Yormark on Barclays Center
item.description:
“It’s one train stop from Barclays Center and 15 to 20 minutes by car. Most importantly, it’s a great recruiting chip.”

Brett Yormark on Barclays Center, Jun 6, 2016. Source: NetsDaily.
